# PR — 327_R7UX.4 — one visual language for the dossier + FAQ disclosure styling (BL-95)

PR: [#421](https://github.com/SteveVitali/Rhema/pull/421)
Base: `stevenvitali/r7ux-3-files-panel-polish` · Head: `stevenvitali/r7ux-4-dossier-visual-unify` @ `6634f8cf`
mergePolicy: OPERATOR (stacks bottom-up)

## Summary

- `packages/ui/src/dossier.tsx` — `DossierView` now mounts
  `article.paper.ui-dsv` inside a `<div data-paper="light">` pin: the SAME
  mechanism the in-app dossier rides (`[data-paper="light"] .paper` →
  `paperScopeVars("light")` + the serif paper typeset — `ide-shell.tsx:270`'s
  `.paper` under `<html data-paper="light">`). Before this, the public sample
  dossier read the default `:root` DARK paper tokens — the dark-sans second
  language BL-95 closes. The pin lives inside the component, so all four public
  consumers (landing, invite, signup-sent, /showcase) unify at one fix point.
  Zero copied values.
- `apps/web/src/marketing.tsx` — the FAQ's
  `<summary class="ui-accordion-trigger">` carries
  `ChevronDown ui-icon ui-accordion-chevron` — the same marker the Accordion
  primitive renders. The native `<details>` stays (RV-36 no-JS contract); the
  redundant inline flex style drops (the class supplies it).
- `packages/tokens/src/theme-css.ts` — the CSS-only twin of the scripted
  `aria-expanded` arm: `details.ui-accordion-item > summary` gets
  `list-style:none` + `::-webkit-details-marker { display:none }`, and the
  chevron rotates on `[open]`. Placed beside the `data-collapsed-group` native
  arm because `uiCss()`/`uiTailCss()` are at their REQ-KIT-5 bounds (9 B / 27 B
  headroom); `themeCss()` has no bound and already owns native-element theming.
- `apps/web/src/dom-contract.ts` — `data-paper` emittedBy extended to
  `ui/dossier.tsx` (no new hooks).

## Acceptance → evidence

- Sample dossier renders with the in-app token set, asserted as the shared
  class/token source (never a copied hex) → `ui.test.tsx` (`.paper` under
  `data-paper=light`) + `marketing.test.ts` (served doc carries the pin + the
  `[data-paper] .paper` scope rules + `--paper-bg`/`--font-paper` tokens).
- FAQ `<details>` with the styled marker, opens without JS →
  `landing-faq.dom.test.tsx` (new): native `<details>/<summary>` with
  `ui-accordion-chevron`, no aria-expanded/role, `[open]` toggles with zero JS.
- Out of scope held → no copy, sections, or marketing nav touched.
